name: imprnt-plugin-kleinanzeigen
description: imprnt plugin: a watcher for your Kleinanzeigen message box. Deterministic regex triage of buyer messages, template drafts, a phone digest; you press send. Never sends on its own.

scripts.build: bun build src/check.ts --target=node --outfile=check.js --banner '#!/usr/bin/env node' && bun build src/kleinanzeigen.ts --target=node --outfile=kleinanzeigen.js --banner '#!/usr/bin/env node'

author: Aleksandr Bogdanov
